beats.narration: Your favorite app can disappear. Your data should not disappear with it.

shots.scene: a cloud app card vanishes while a folder of user files remains
shots.element_motion: the app card tears away, files slide into a local folder, warning scraps flutter

beats.narration: Local-first software keeps a usable copy on your device, so work continues offline and your files remain portable.

shots.scene: a laptop holding a durable file archive with offline and export badges
shots.element_motion: the archive locks into place, offline badge lights, export cards fan outward and settle
